notes.title: The latest update for JUMP JUMP CYBERPUNK is here! 🌟
notes.content:
Embark on a brand-new adventure in the [b]Fantasy world[/b], featuring six new levels, each with its own unique environment, challenges, and enemies. This expansion will take your gaming experience to the next level!

We've also introduced a new movement mechanic, allowing for smoother and more dynamic exploration, perfectly suited to the design of the new levels. Additionally, we've revamped the HUD with a new world selection system, making navigation easier and more accessible.

Don’t miss out on this exciting update—get ready for the most epic adventure yet!

notes.title: NEW RELEASE : Jump Jump Cyberpunk
notes.content:
👽 Welcome to a new world within jump jump cyberpunk, cowboys vs aliens 👽

In this world you will find countless new obstacles related to cowboys and aliens, which, together with the music created specifically for each level, you will not be able to stop playing. 

You will have three levels of two heights and two levels of three heights, you will have to overcome static and moving objects to be able to face the final boss in the last level, it will not be easy, but it will be exciting and fun. To enjoy 🤠
